subject.title: fix(cli): clean up abandoned egress opens to prevent conn+goroutine leak

question: Should this PR require a live mediated-egress run, or should the websocket regression receive an explicit proof override?
rationale: Only a maintainer with coordinator and lease access can validate the unchanged host reaction in the real paired bridge or intentionally waive that external-PR proof requirement.

options.title: Require live egress proof
options.body: Run a timeout or cancellation through a real coordinator-paired lease and capture redacted logs showing host cleanup and a successful subsequent open.

options.title: Record proof override
options.body: Accept the deterministic websocket regression as sufficient because the omitted host close handler is pre-existing and unchanged.

recommendation.title: Require live egress proof
recommendation.body: Run a timeout or cancellation through a real coordinator-paired lease and capture redacted logs showing host cleanup and a successful subsequent open.

likelyOwner.reason: Already requested review and managed merge automation for this PR, so is the strongest available owner for the proof decision.
